entities.summary: Mikhail Vasilyevich Nesterov was a Russian and Soviet painter; associated with the Peredvizhniki and Mir iskusstva. He was one of the first exponents of Symbolist art in Russia. Mikhail Nesterov was a philosophers & thinkers from Ufa (1862-05-31, Ufa–1942-10-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
